test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following cities does not form a part of tourist circuit 'The Golden Triangle'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Golden Triangle' tourist circuit in India does not connect Lucknow.
 
• India’s 'Golden Triangle' is a tourist circuit that does not connect the city of Lucknow.
 
 
• India's golden triangle is a tourist circuit that connects the national capital Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur.
 
• The Golden Triangle is so-called because of the triangular shape formed by the locations of New Delhi, Agra, and Rajasthan on a map.
